newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz details 96 German non-life premiums.
newsitem.headline: Allianz details 96 German non-life premiums.

text.p: Year to December 31, 1996 (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)

NOTE - Full name of the German insurer is Allianz Versicherungs AG, the German non-life unit of Allianz AG Holding. All figures are provisional. The unit's chairman Reiner Hagemann told a news conference that the drop in premium income was the unit's first in post-war times.
East German business increased slightly as the region catches up with the west in terms of cover.
The fall-off in motor insurance premium income overall was due to price pressures.
Hagemann also said Allianz had regained market share in the year and noted a marked increase in new business in third-party motor liability insurance, which rose two percent to 850,000 policies.
Favorable weather developments and a 20 percent decline in car theft limited major claims.
